_help: Links (sections, hero button, and cards in cards.json) all share one format: route (key of endpoints.routes) OR href; external:true to open in a new tab; label_key (i18n key) OR label (text or {"en":..,"es":..}); icon (name, or false for none); enabled:false to switch it off. Text fallbacks: link_label in the section's i18n namespace, then common.learn_more. Delete `link` (or the whole section) to remove it.
